finalText:
The mission list now has All / Open / Done buttons and a "Showing X of Y" count. All 9 tests pass, including the 4 new filter tests. I haven't run the app in a browser.

- **Filter:** All is the default. The active button is highlighted and exposes `aria-pressed`.
- **Count:** it updates as you switch filters, for example "Showing 2 of 3".
- **Empty cases:** if a filter matches nothing, you get "No done missions." and the buttons stay visible, so you can switch back. The "No missions on the board." message still shows when the log itself is empty.

The changes are in `mission-list.ts`, `mission-list.html`, `mission-list.css` and `mission-list.spec.ts`, all under `src/app/missions/`. I didn't commit anything.
